candidates.rationale: Levamisole has a median pChEMBL affinity of 4.71 against ALPL, measured at assay confidence score 9, and is an approved drug with a Tanimoto similarity of 0.968 to the nearest approved drug levamisole hydrochloride. The ALPL target has eight recorded BioGRID physical or genetic interactors: FBXO6, EEF1A1, SRPK2, ALOX5, SPCS2, SEC11C, MAPKAPK2, and PIK3C2B.
